'''Ilya G. Usoskin'''<ref>{{Cite Q|Q56559861}}</ref> is a Finnish astrophysicist who is a professor at [[University of Oulu]] and head of Cosmic Ray Station at [[Sodankylä]] Geophysical Observatory. He is a Vice President of the [[International Astronomical Union]] since 2021.<ref name="IAU EC">{{cite web| title=IAU| url=https://www.iau.org/administration/executive_bodies/executive_committee/| website=www.iau.org/administration/executive_bodies/executive_committee/| access-date=2024-05-29| archive-date=2024-03-02| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240302030136/https://iau.org/administration/executive_bodies/executive_committee/}}</ref><ref name="IAU Usoskin">{{cite web|title = IAU Usoskin|url=https://www.iau.org/administration/membership/individual/13681/
|website=www.iau.org/administration/membership/individual/13681/}}</ref>

==Education==
<!-- {{BLP unreferenced section|date=June 2024}} -->
In 1982, Ilya Usoskin graduated from the [[Saint Petersburg Lyceum 239]]<ref name="School 239">{{cite web| title=School 239 alumni| url=http://zs.239store.ru/| website=zs.239store.ru}}</ref> with intensified study of physics and mathematics, in parallel with [[Grigory Perelman]].
Then he became a student at the [[Peter the Great St. Petersburg Polytechnic University]] and finished it as an MSc in physics (Space Physics) in 1988.

==Career==
<!-- {{BLP unreferenced section|date=June 2024}} -->
Since 1988, he worked as a junior researcher in the field of Astrophysics at the [[Ioffe Institute]], where he obtained the [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree in astrophysics in 1995.<ref>{{cite web| title =Ioffe library| url=http://ecatalog.rasl.ru:8080/cgi-bin/irbis64r_11/cgiirbis_64.exe?LNG=&Z21ID=&I21DBN=FTI&P21DBN=FTI&S21STN=1&S21REF=3&S21FMT=fullwebr&C21COM=S&S21CNR=20&S21P01=0&S21P02=1&S21P03=A=&S21STR=%D0%A3%D1%81%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BD,%20%D0%98.%20%D0%93.}}</ref> During 1997–1999, he was a postdoctoral researcher at the [[INFN]] Milano working on the [[Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer]] experiment.<ref>{{cite web| title=INFN Milano AS group| url=https://ams02.space/collaboration/institute/infn-and-university-milano-bicocca| website=ams02.space/collaboration/institute/infn-and-university-milano-bicocca}}</ref> 
Since 2000, he has been a staff of the [[University of Oulu]]—head of the Oulu Cosmic Ray station.<ref>{{cite web| title = Oulu Cosmic Ray Station| url = https://cosmicrays.oulu.fi | website = cosmicrays.oulu.fi}}</ref>

In 2000, he got [[PhD]] in Space Physics,<ref name="PhD"/> in 2002, he became a [[Docent]], and a full permanent [[Professor]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web |title = Oulu Staff|url = https://www.oulu.fi/en/researchers/ilya-usoskin| website = www.oulu.fi/en/researchers/ilya-usoskin}}</ref>
In 2014-2015, he was a visiting professor at [[IPGP]].
Currently (2025-2027), he is also a Designated professor at [[Nagoya University]].

==Recognition and honors==
* 2013: Knight's Cross, First Class, of the [[Order of the Lion of Finland]] for the promotion of national science.<ref>{{cite web|title = Kaleva|url=https://www.kaleva.fi/kunniamerkit-julkistettiin-katso-lista-pohjoisen-p/1728379|website=www.kaleva.fi/kunniamerkit-julkistettiin-katso-lista-pohjoisen-p/1728379}}</ref> 
* 2015-2024: member of C4 (Astroparticle Physics) of [[IUPAP]].<ref>{{cite web| title=IUPAP C4| url= https://iupap.org/who-we-are/internal-organization/commissions/c4-astroparticle-physics/| website= iupap.org/who-we-are/internal-organization/commissions/c4-astroparticle-physics/| date= 10 February 2021}}</ref> 
* 2018: Julius Bartels medal of the [[European Geosciences Union]] for the foundation of the [[Space Climate]] discipline.<ref>{{cite web|title = EGU Bartels medal|url=https://www.egu.eu/awards-medals/julius-bartels/2018/ilya-g-usoskin/ |website=www.egu.eu/awards-medals/julius-bartels/2018/ilya-g-usoskin}}</ref>
* 2019: elected member of the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite web| title=Academy members| url=https://acadsci.fi/jasenet/kotimaiset-jasenet/| website=acadsci.fi/jasenet/kotimaiset-jasenet/ }}</ref>
* 2020: Annual Award of the ISEE of [[Nagoya University]]<ref>{{cite web|title = ISEE|url=https://www.isee.nagoya-u.ac.jp/en/news/2021/the-3rd-isee-award-to-prof-ilya-usoskin-and-dr-stepan-poluianov-university-of-oulu-finland.html| website=www.isee.nagoya-u.ac.jp/en/news/2021/the-3rd-isee-award-to-prof-ilya-usoskin-and-dr-stepan-poluianov-university-of-oulu-finland.html}}</ref> for research of extreme solar events.
* 2021-2027: Vice President of the [[International Astronomical Union]].<ref name="IAU EC"/>

==Major research grants==
* [[European Research Council]] Synergy Grant ''GERACLE'' (2025–2031)<ref>{{cite web| title=ERC SyG list 2024| url=https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/erc-2024-synergy-grants-results| website=erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/erc-2024-synergy-grants-results }}</ref> -- PI.
* Finnish Centre of Excellence of the [[Academy of Finland]] ''ReSoLVE'' (2014–2019)<ref>{{cite web| title=ReSoLVE| url=http://satdat.oulu.fi/space_climate/resolve/| website=satdat.oulu.fi/space_climate/resolve/ }}</ref> -- (vice) Director.
* Finnish Centre of Excellence of the [[Research Council of Finland]] in ''Space Resilience'' (2026-2033)<ref>{{cite web| title=SpaceResilence| url=https://www.aka.fi/en/research-funding/funding-opportunities2/programmes-and-other-funding-schemes/finnish-centres-of-excellence/coe-programme-20262033/finnish-centre-of-excellence-in-space-resilience-spaceresilience/| website=www.aka.fi/en/research-funding/funding-opportunities2/programmes-and-other-funding-schemes/finnish-centres-of-excellence/coe-programme-20262033/finnish-centre-of-excellence-in-space-resilience-spaceresilience/ }}</ref> -- Task leader

==Research==
Usoskin works in the fields of [[Solar Physics]], [[Cosmic Rays]], [[Heliosphere]] and [[Space Climate]]. He has co-authored more than 400 research publications with tens of thousands of citations.<ref>{{cite web|title = ORCID|url=https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8227-9081| website=orcid.org/0000-0001-8227-9081}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title = Scopus|url=https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=7004683817|website=www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=7004683817}}</ref>

His main research achievements include:
*	Foundation of a new research discipline [[Space Climate]], focused on long-term global changes in the terrestrial and near-Earth environment;
*	Invention of a novel method to model atmospheric effects of cosmic rays;
*	Invention of a novel method of past solar activity reconstructions using [[cosmogenic isotopes]];
*	Foundation of a new paradigm of extreme solar events known also as [[Miyake event]]s.
